Reading the image as a bowl about 15 cm across, the food appears to be scrambled eggs, greens (spinach or kale), tomato pieces, possibly rice or potatoes, and a few other bits.

The bowl looks fairly full but shallow, so I estimate about 250 g of food in total:
- Scrambled eggs, about 100 g at roughly 150 kcal.
- Greens, tomato and onion, about 70 g at roughly 40 kcal.
- Rice or potato underneath, about 80 g at roughly 100 kcal.
- Added oil, about 40 kcal.

That adds up to roughly 330 kcal, which I round to 330.
